annotations.title: New tenders of a saved search

description: Tender alerts for an agent: the tenders of one saved tender search that arrived after `cursor`. Returns {events: [] or [one digest: counts by status and country, top 20 tenders, search_url], cursor, truncated, next_check_after}. Keep the returned cursor and pass it on the next call; without a cursor the call covers the last 24 hours. New data arrives once a day (check after next_check_after, about 06:30 UTC). Requires a user API key. Without a plan: the window is at most the last 24 hours, and 10 different saved searches a day (error free_limit after that).

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous call.

saved_search_id.description: Id of a saved tender search.
